column3: Close to the Hebrew.
NASB supplies “the distance.”
NASB supplies “that is” to join “the city” and “the elders of that city.”
“a valley with running water” renders “an ever-flowing wadi.”
“assault” renders “wound”; “shall be settled by them” renders “shall be on their mouth.”
“the valley” renders “the wadi.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Forgive” renders “Make atonement for”; NASB adds “the guilt of,” and “the bloodguiltiness shall be forgiven them” renders “the blood shall be atoned for them.”
NASB adds “the guilt of”; “when” renders “for.”
“them” and “hands” are plural for the Hebrew singular “him … your hand.”
“have a desire for her” renders “love her.”
“trim her nails” renders “attend to her nails.”
“a full month” renders “a month of days.”
“wherever she wishes” renders “for her soul”; “mistreat” renders “treat as a slave.”
“unloved” renders “hated.”
“he wills what he has to his sons” renders “he causes his sons to inherit what he has”; “unloved” renders “hated.”
“a double portion” renders “a mouth of two”; “strength” renders “manly vigor.”
“chastise” renders “discipline.”
“the gateway of his home town” renders “the gate of his place.”
“obey us” renders “listen to our voice.”
“stone him to death” renders “stone him with stones, and he shall die.”
“worthy of death” renders “a sentence of death.”
NASB puts “for he who is hanged is accursed of God” in parentheses.
